document.cue: Describe a film that you enjoyed watching.

text: I'd like to talk about a film called The Pursuit of Happyness, which I watched about two years ago with my family. I think it came out in 2006, so it's quite old, but my father recommended it, and we watched it together on a rainy Sunday. I had heard a lot about it from my friends, so I was really curious.

The main actor is Will Smith, and his real son, Jaden, plays his child in the film, which I found really touching. The story is about a man called Chris who is a salesman with very little money. He loses his home, and he has to sleep in public toilets and shelters with his small son. In spite of all that, he never gives up, and he works for a company for free as an intern, hoping to get a job at the end. There are many difficult moments, and I must admit that I cried several times. The film is based on a true story, which makes it even more powerful, and I later read a few articles about the real man.

I enjoyed the film because it's very inspiring. It shows that if you keep trying and believe in yourself, you can achieve something even when everything seems against you. The acting is also excellent, and the music makes it more emotional. After I watched it, I felt more motivated to study hard. I would recommend it to anyone who is feeling discouraged, and I'm sure I'll watch it again one day.

tips.en: Every bullet is covered in order, so the talk sounds complete.
tips.kk: Жоспардың әр тармағы ретімен ашылған, сондықтан әңгіме тұтас естіледі.
tips.ru: Каждый пункт плана раскрыт по порядку, поэтому рассказ звучит целостно.
tips.example: I'd like to talk about a film called The Pursuit of Happyness

tips.en: 'In spite of' shows the hero's strength and adds depth.
tips.kk: «In spite of» тіркесі кейіпкердің күшін көрсетіп, тереңдік қосады.
tips.ru: Выражение «in spite of» показывает силу героя и добавляет глубину.
tips.example: In spite of all that, he never gives up

tips.en: The film's message in a conditional explains why you enjoyed it.
tips.kk: Фильмнің мәні шартты сөйлем арқылы неге ұнағанын түсіндіреді.
tips.ru: Мораль фильма через условное предложение объясняет, почему он понравился.
tips.example: It shows that if you keep trying and believe in yourself, you can achieve something even when everything seems against you
